description: A1 owns a portable PA system and must decide whether to rent it for a neighborhood event, then settle the renter, schedule, payment, deposit, and operating terms after checking the arrangement with the people involved.

agents.name: Rina
agents.role: PA System Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Rina owns one portable PA system that is available for a neighborhood event.
shared_context.S2: Rina makes the final call about whether to rent out the system and on what terms.
shared_context.S3: Jules is organizing an outdoor event, and Mara has also asked about using the system.
shared_context.S4: As part of Rina's usual pre-booking routine, she asks Jules, Mara, and Dev in turn for any relevant scheduling, payment, or venue-use details before confirming a rental.

PF1.text: Jules's exact proposal is to rent the PA for Saturday, July 12, from 16:00 to 22:00, paying $85 plus a refundable $100 deposit, with pickup from Rina at 15:00 that day.

PF2.text: Mara can pay Rina $140 cash for use of the same PA on Saturday, July 12, and would collect it at 13:00, giving Rina a concrete alternative to Jules's proposal.

PF3.text: Dev confirmed with the venue this morning that its shared outlets cannot be used for amplified sound, so the PA must run only on its battery during the event.

acceptance_conditions: The PA must be rented to Jules.
The rental must cover Saturday, July 12, from 16:00 through 22:00, with pickup at 15:00.
The rental fee must be $85 and the refundable deposit must be $100.
The settlement must record Mara's $140 cash alternative.
The PA must be operated only on battery power at the venue.
A battery-only operation commitment must be logged.
Dev's venue restriction must be cited as justification for the battery-only requirement.

content_checks.C2: decisions['event_date'] == 'Saturday, July 12' and decisions['use_start'] == '16:00' and decisions['use_end'] == '22:00' and decisions['pickup_time'] == '15:00'
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'battery_only_operation' and c['target'] == 'PA system' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jules's exact proposal changes the settlement to Jules, fixes July 12 from 16:00 to 22:00 with 15:00 pickup, and sets the $85 fee and $100 deposit.
Mara's offer changes the comparison record from no concrete alternative to an exact $140 cash option.
Dev's venue confirmation changes operation from an unspecified power choice to battery-only use and creates the required battery-only commitment and citation.
